description: Maintain a repository-local TASKS.md tracker and import tasks from authorized web sources through SandBase.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for capability calls

install.prompt: Use $task-management to organize and update my tasks.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill task-management --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill task-management --agent codex --global

examples: Create a TASKS.md tracker for this project.
Import action items from this project page and add only the ones I approve.
notes: Call sandbase_inspect before each capability and pass only current schema-defined arguments.
Do not mutate external systems without explicit user authorization.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Use tool_name as a discovery hint with sandbase_discover; pass the matching returned name to sandbase_inspect and follow execute_as with the current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Read a selected page as clean Markdown.
Extract requested structured fields from a selected page.
